historical_record.description: A permit was sought for alterations for store and dwelling, estimated at $3,000. J. C. Hladik was named as architect.

Sold for $25,000, deed recorded September 24, 1970. The Redevelopment Agency's appraisers, filing it as a comparable sale, described wood-frame building with a store below a five-room flat, built about 1915.
